units.source_text: “很早以前……在北山砍杉树枝，从这棵树荡到另一棵树时，没悠荡好，

en.t: A long time ago, while cutting cedar branches in Kitayama, he was swinging from this tree to another, but he did not swing properly,

units.source_text: 掉落下来，摔在致命的地方……

en.t: and he fell down and struck a fatal spot...
That is what I heard from the people in the village.

units.source_text: 那时我刚出生，什么也不知道……”

en.t: At that time I had just been born, so I knew nothing about it..."
